name: settlement amplitude
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
usage_overview: 在基础沉降影响分析中，作为控制沉降最大值的几何参数，用于设置和比较不同沉降程度，考察其对弹性支承块式无砟轨道变形及离缝的影响。

complete_examples.text: It is shown that the increase of settlement amplitude and decrease of settlement wavelength lead to higher damage degree in amplitude and wider spatial distribution.
With the increase of settlement amplitude, the interfacial damage on both sides gradually appears and shows a tendency to expand toward the center part.
In summary, the settlement amplitude is strongly positively correlated with the deformation of the track structure.
